title: Review of lab 1's fl_forager_mut (I) on fresh seeds 5 and 6: food-eating Flow-Lenia bodies keep their shape for 240-360 t between collisions, while labkit's tracks churn (merges 0.92-0.93 of splits, no persistent tracks)
summary: labkit re-runs of threads/flow-lenia/worlds/fl_forager_mut/world.py on fresh seeds 5 and 6 with the pack's settings (frames 400, spf 20, t=1600, 128^2). 9-18 bodies per run (occupancy 0.10-0.11). 385/498 tracks, none persistent for half the run, splits 130/172 vs merges 119/160 (original pack: 510 tracks, 177 splits, 169 merges). The top tracks in rerun/seed5/tracks.png keep a stable body for 240-360 t between collisions: #118 a cyan ring t=712-1076, #65 a ring that tidies up t=388-684, #286 a magenta body t=1292-1532. Bodies glide (36/50 tracks >= 1 body length, max 12.9/14.1). I counts under the RUBRIC L2 rule for colliding populations, judged from the images.

observations.I: rerun/seed5/tracks.png: #118 (t=712-1076), #65 (388-684), #286 (1292-1532) keep a stable body between collisions

verdicts.limitation: Identity churns at collisions (merges ~ splits), so I rests on the images, not on labkit persistence. The mutation and heredity parts of lab 1's claim (L6/L7, Weak) were not examined.
